quests.name: Trouble with Ghosts
quests.summary: The banker wants the ghost near Fenoburn thinned out.
intro: The ghost beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 12 of them close to Fenoburn and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Maple Logs
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Fenoburn has run out of maple logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 24 maple logs and nobody in Fenoburn has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Fenoburn to the food shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the food shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the General Store Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the general store keeper of Fenoburn and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the general store keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Fenoburn Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Fenoburn Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Fenoburn Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Short on Raw Lobster
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Fenoburn has run out of raw lobster.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 19 raw lobster and nobody in Fenoburn has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Fenoburn to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Fenoburn Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Fenoburn Sewers and tell the sword shop keeper.
intro: Fenoburn Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 19 of them, then let the sword shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Fenoburn owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Fenoburn Sewers is clearer than it was. 19 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Pelenstead
quests.summary: Gather raw tuna for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Pelenstead.
intro: I have an order from Pelenstead and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 19 raw tuna, then take the packed shipment to the general store keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Fenoburn.
From Fenoburn? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Fenoburn and bring back maple logs.
intro: The wilds around Fenoburn need a firm hand. Start with 12 spider outside the walls, then 19 giant rat down in Fenoburn Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 24 maple logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Fenoburn for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the banker, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the fishing shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the banker.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

quests.name: The Fall of the Fallen Warden
quests.summary: March on Meadow Keep, break its creatures and bring down The Fallen Warden.
intro: Meadow Keep has stood against Fenoburn for too long. The Fallen Warden sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the sword shop keeper, fight your way through 29 zombie and end The Fallen Warden.
Bring 19 raw tuna back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Meadow Keep?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Fallen Warden rules it now.
player: Word from Fenoburn: The Fallen Warden is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Fenoburn Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Fenoburn and Pelenstead.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Pelenstead. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 29 ghost near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Fenoburn.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Pelenstead is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Fenoburn has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Fenoburn
quests.summary: Find what rules Fenoburn Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Fenoburn Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the fishing shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Fenoburn is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Fenoburn Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
